styles.title: Wo's Maple Tee
styles.description: Meet the AS Colour Maple Tee, tailored especially for women. Embrace comfort and durability with mid weight 5.3 oz 100% combed cotton. This tee offers a regular fit, complete with neck ribbing and double needle hems for enduring quality and minimal shrinkage. Built to last.

styles.title: Wo's Classic Crop Tee
styles.description: Explore the AS Colour Women's Classic Cropped Tee, ideal for printing with its cropped relaxed fit and heavy weight 6.5 oz, 22-singles 100% combed cotton. Built to last with neck ribbing, side seams, shoulder-to-shoulder tape, and double needle hems, plus preshrunk fabric for minimal shrinkage.

styles.title: Classic Tee
styles.description: The timeless AS Colour Classic Tee, ideal for printing with its regular fit and heavy weight 6.5 oz, 22-singles 100% combed cotton. Built to last with neck ribbing, side seams, shoulder-to-shoulder tape, and double needle hems, plus preshrunk fabric for minimal shrinkage.

styles.title: Heavy Faded L/S Tee
styles.description: The AS Colour Heavy Faded Long Sleeve Tee, crafted from 100% carded cotton for durability and comfort. With a heavy 7.1 oz weight and garment dyed finish, it features a boxy relaxed fit, dropped shoulders, and twin-stitched wide neck ribbing. Built to last for a timeless, relaxed look.

styles.title: Supply Crew
styles.description: Featuring comfort and style with the AS Colour Supply Crew. This mid-weight sweatshirt features raglan sleeves, ribbed cuffs, and neckline for a classic fit. Crafted from anti-pill fleece and pre-shrunk cotton blend, it ensures durability and minimal shrinkage.

styles.title: Supply Hood
styles.description: Elevate your casual wardrobe with the AS Colour Supply Hood. This essential hoodie offers a regular fit with a mid weight feel, crafted from cotton rich anti-pill fleece. It includes a cozy hood, ribbed cuffs, and a tear-out label for added comfort and style.

styles.title: Coach Jacket
styles.description: The AS Colour Coach Jacket, a regular fitting outerwear style crafted from light weight nylon with a polyester lining. Features include a collared design, snap dome closure, two side pockets, and elastic cuffs. Complete with a drawcord hem for a versatile, functional style.

styles.title: Chore Jacket
styles.description: Introducing the AS Colour Chore Jacket, made from heavy weight cotton drill with a washed finish. This collared shirt jacket features four pockets and corozo buttons for closure, offering durability and timeless style.

styles.description: Regular Fit - Light Weight

styles.title: Stencil Track Pants
styles.description: Discover comfort with the AS Colour Stencil Trackpants. These mid-heavy weight bottoms offer a regular fit, crafted from cotton rich anti-pill fleece. Featuring self-fabric elasticated waistband and hem cuffs, along with a tonal drawcord and two side pockets, they are pre-shrunk for enduring wear. Saving approx. 5.5 500ml plastic bottles from landfill.

styles.title: Relax Track Shorts 18"
styles.description: Elevate your casual style with the AS Colour Relax Track Shorts. Crafted from a blend of cotton and recycled polyester fleece, these mid weight shorts offer a relaxed fit, an elasticated waistband with a tonal drawcord, and practical pockets for everyday convenience. Saving approx. 5 500ml plastic bottles from landfill.

styles.title: Relax Cuffless Track Pants
styles.description: Relax cuffless trackpants in mid-weight 320 GSM fabric with 80% cotton and 20% recycled polyester. Features elastic waistband, tonal drawcord, two side pockets, and one back pocket. Saving approx. 3 500ml plastic bottles from landfill.
